title: Bound global nonnegative charging from the 23 physical C5 floors
body:
## Summary

```text
23 physical C5 cost20 premises
  + nonnegative weights
  + unrestricted termwise full-plane rank charging
  -> numerical floor at most 180/7
  -> no real global floor of 26 or integer floor of 27 by this method
```

Add only `research/c5-global-charging-ceiling/`. This takes PR3281's global-charging handoff without repeating the local floors. Uniform aggregation has the stronger ceiling 4140/193. These limit the specified proof method, not the optimal decoder. No supplier or kappa change is claimed.

[PROOF.md](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6633669da0cc258e655fead0c4274b1bffbd3467/research/c5-global-charging-ceiling/PROOF.md) gives the real-weight argument. One full-support rectangle has global rank nine and restricted ranks seven, eight and nine with multiplicities four, six and thirteen. Their sum is 193. A deliberately inefficient 114-term identity fit shows that its cancelling full-support terms are admissible. Optimal/cancellation-free and fit-level arguments remain outside scope.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3279/3281 complete the local cost20 conclusions but leave a valid global charge open. After: this test limits every nonnegative weight choice in the stated termwise method. It does not prove that the ceiling is attainable against every rectangle.
- Two exact implementations agree. The separate dense-rank implementation checks all 3,819,816 five-subsets. Both scalar constructions check all 12,544 entries. Nine behavioral groups cover 1,330 weight controls, integer seams, wrong sign, both input corruptions, receipt failures and exclusive outputs.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, ordinary CPython 3.13.5 tests, Ruff and formatting pass. All 12 package/input publication-byte checks pass at the exact head. A read-only Git-free committed export passes all three scripts under optimized CPython 3.13.5 and preserves all 13 export files.
- Both live inputs and every provenance object are on canonical main. No unrelated unmerged PR Git object or executable is needed. Main `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a` and priority revision 6 were unchanged at submission refresh. Hosted CI is separate and will be checked on the exact head.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/c5-global-charging-ceiling
```

No independent human/proof-kernel review, global decoder theorem, native/dirty restoration, physical/precision invoice, supplier admission or selected cold replay is claimed. Open next questions and the narrow-and-stop decision are in the package.

Credit PR3281/Krzysztof Wójt, PR3256/Sagar Thakrar, PR3248/3268/3271/3279, Tekalign/PR2782, Cinna Davis/PR1825, Adam Gall/PR1889 and the retained E8/P112 lineage. [Canonical predecessor investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587). No new Discussion post under this session's communication restriction.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One opt-in package. Shared code, frozen sources and the selected result are unchanged. Archival retention does not admit a supplier or frontier update.
